kind: Real Django + React + live PubMed smoke test

checks.name: Registration and authenticated session survive a page reload
Short Chinese clinical query maps to English and retrieves live PubMed records
Answer save is visible and persists after reload
Structured evidence table remains contained on a narrow screen
PDF downloads through authenticated export endpoint
Official ESearch + ESummary + EFetch resolves known PMID and separate publication dates
Preferences persist with visible save confirmation
Profile save and immediate logout clear the authenticated UI
Saved answer remains after sign-out and sign-in
Mobile drawer reaches Profile without page overflow
Second account cannot access the first account answer, history, or saved publications
